front: Why was Pearl Harbor a strategic failure for Japan?
back: The US carriers, fuel tanks and yards survived, most battleships were repaired, and the attack united the USA for war.

front: Why did Japan capture Malaya and Singapore so quickly?
back: Control of the air and sea, experienced and fast-moving troops, and poorly trained and equipped British forces.

front: Why was Midway a turning point?
back: Japan lost four fleet carriers and skilled aircrew, ending its offensive power; US industry could replace losses far faster.
